lines.zh: 我一段一段地挪，身子弓起来。
lines.en: I inch along, my body arching.
I crawl along the vein to the leaf's tip.

lines.zh: 我用后面的脚抓住叶子。
lines.en: My hind feet grip the leaf.
This leaf has gone a little yellow.

lines.zh: 我用腹足吸住叶面，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: My prolegs grip the leaf as I creep across it.

lines.zh: 再过去就是枝条了，我不敢。
lines.en: Beyond is the twig, and I don't dare.

lines.zh: 我绕着叶子边缘走了一圈。
lines.en: I work my way around the leaf's edge.
When I've eaten, I crawl two laps.

lines.zh: 我身上的毛碰到叶子会响。
lines.en: My hairs rasp against the leaf.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方留下小洞。
lines.en: Little holes are left where I've been.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶子背面躲一会儿。
lines.en: I crawl under the leaf to hide a while.

lines.zh: 我努力够到下一片叶子。
lines.en: I stretch for the next leaf.
The wind tilts the leaf, and I hold tight.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把自己卷起来。
lines.en: I stop and curl myself up.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，看枝条之间。
lines.en: I lift my head and look between the twigs.
I climb up the trunk.
I lie in the middle of the leaf, still.

lines.zh: 我把自己弯成一段小拱。
lines.en: I bend into a small arch.

lines.zh: 叶子上还有我咬过的痕。
lines.en: The marks of my chewing are still on the leaf.
I'm not very good at walking.
My hairs are soft.
When a bird calls, I flatten myself.
I pull my head in.
I count the veins and drift off.
I slowly circle on the leaf's surface.
I need to eat a little more.
My skin is feeling tight.
I need to finish eating before dark.
Don't lift the leaf away.
Where are you taking me?
I have only one leaf.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛一撮一撮，扎手。
lines.en: The tufts on my back prickle.
Don't squeeze me; I'll burst.

lines.zh: 你可以把我放回叶子上。
lines.en: You can put me back on a leaf.
I smell a different tree.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，看不见全貌。
lines.en: I look up and can't see all of you.

lines.zh: 你的手指上有一片叶子。
lines.en: There's a leaf on your finger.

lines.zh: 叶子之外的东西，我一概不碰。
lines.en: Anything other than a leaf, I won't touch.
I go stiff all over.
I fall onto the leaf beside.
Some of my hairs have broken.

lines.zh: 我把带毛的身子卷成一个环。
lines.en: I roll my bristly body into a ring.
I can't lift my head.
A spot on me is wet.
I shake my fuzz into a little cloud.
I cling to the leaf vein.
I bite down on the leaf.
I hide under the leaf.
That leaf is fresh.
I reach my head toward it.
Only leaves; nothing else will do.
I take a bite, and it's good.
Could I have a few more leaves?
I'm full halfway through.
There's dew on your leaf.
I nibble along the edge.
This tastes right.
I've only just eaten and I'm hungry again.
I wobble at the leaf tip.
I slipped on the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我的脚全滑开了。
lines.en: The leaf lurched, and every foot of mine slipped.

lines.zh: 别推这片叶子，我还没化蛹。
lines.en: Do not push this leaf; I have not pupated.
I rolled to the leaf's edge.
My hairs stand up.
This below me isn't a leaf.
I pull my front half back.
I'm too far above the ground.
You shifted me a little.

lines.zh: 另一条毛虫在隔壁叶子上。
lines.en: Another caterpillar is on the next leaf.
A twig separates us.
Our leaves are almost touching.
I crawl toward her side.
We touch heads, lightly.
This wood can feed plenty of us.
Afterward we each eat on our own.
We're both growing.

lines.zh: 有一天我会在叶上结茧。
lines.en: One day I'll spin a cocoon on a leaf.
She'll spin a cocoon on a leaf too.

lines.zh: 我用后面的脚抓住这片叶。
lines.en: My hind feet have hold of this leaf.
You took the leaf with me.
I drop into your palm.
My feet can't grip skin.
I bit you, very lightly.
I have no choice but to curl up.

lines.zh: 叶子找不到，我先贴着树皮。
lines.en: No leaf in sight, so I cling to the bark.
I can't stay here long.
I crawl toward your finger.
There's a leaf — hurry.
That leaf is taken.
Something is beside me.

lines.zh: 我支起前半截带毛的身子，朝它探。
lines.en: I rear up my hairy front half and reach toward it.

lines.zh: 这片我吃了一半，不能让。
lines.en: I've eaten half of this, and I won't give it up.
I pull my body taut.

lines.zh: 叶子那头一颤一颤，我盯紧了。
lines.en: The far edge of the leaf keeps trembling; I fix on it.
I'll stay still and watch it first.
I've got it fixed.
I'm going to bump it.
One more approach and I'll act.

lines.zh: 我身上的毛，碰一下会痒。
lines.en: Touch my hairs and you'll itch.
I move along the vein.

lines.zh: 它在我这片叶子的背面。
lines.en: It's on the underside of my leaf.
I keep to the leaf's edge.
A gypsy moth larva's hairs prickle.
I inch a little closer.
I swing my head.
Its antennae are moving.
I'm waiting here.
It's been pushed back a little.
I butted it with my head.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，身上的毛也跟着扎过去。
lines.en: I bite down, and my bristles jab in with it.
My hairs pricked it.
It rolls over and off the leaf.

lines.zh: 它被我的毛刺得缩回去。
lines.en: My bristles make it recoil.
That one missed.
My leaf has been torn.
I retreat to the leaf's tip.
My bite wasn't heavy.
It got away over the leaf's edge.
My first bite is a leaf.

lines.zh: 刚从卵里出来，我就开始啃。
lines.en: Out of the egg, I start chewing.
I chew out a small opening.
Everything here is green.

lines.zh: 我爬上最近的一片叶子。
lines.en: I climb onto the nearest leaf.
I've just bitten through the eggshell.
I begin to eat, slowly.
I'm smaller than a single leaf.
The wind comes, and I hug the leaf.
My appetite will keep growing.
One lick of flame and all my hairs curl.

lines.zh: 离开叶子，地上全是死路。
lines.en: Off the leaf, the ground is all dead ends.

lines.zh: 露水积成一小片，我差点淹住。
lines.en: Dew pools into a puddle and nearly drowns me.
My hairs come off at a touch.

lines.zh: 一根刺扎穿了我旁边的叶子。
lines.en: A thorn pierces the leaf beside me.
That light leaves me numb all over.

lines.zh: 没有叶子吃，我一天天变软。
lines.en: With no leaves, I grow softer by the day.
At the thunder I go completely rigid.
There's no leaf, and no ground.
